Limit
  ->  Sort
        Sort Key: (similarity(entry_5m.name_fold, 'ahmed al'::text)) DESC, entry_5m.name_fold
        ->  Index Scan using entry_5m_list on entry_5m
              Index Cond: ((country_code = 'pk'::text) AND (publish_state = 'published'::text))
              Filter: (((place_path = 'pk.punjab.faisalabad'::text) OR (place_path ~~ 'pk.punjab.faisalabad.%'::text)) AND ((similarity(name_fold, 'ahmed al'::text) >= '0.25'::double precision) OR (hashed SubPlan 1) OR (name_fold ~~ '%ahmed al%'::text)))
              SubPlan 1
                ->  Seq Scan on variant_5m
                      Filter: (similarity(text_fold, 'ahmed al'::text) >= '0.25'::double precision)

Limit
  ->  Sort
        Sort Key: static_score DESC
        ->  Bitmap Heap Scan on entry_5m
              Recheck Cond: (name_fold ~~ '%ahmed al%'::text)
              Filter: ((publish_state = 'published'::text) AND (country_code = 'pk'::text) AND ((place_path = 'pk.punjab.faisalabad'::text) OR (place_path ~~ 'pk.punjab.faisalabad.%'::text)))
              ->  Bitmap Index Scan on entry_5m_trgm
                    Index Cond: (name_fold ~~ '%ahmed al%'::text)

Limit
  ->  Sort

        ->  Subquery Scan on c
              ->  Limit
                    ->  Sort
                          Sort Key: entry_5m.static_score DESC
                          ->  Bitmap Heap Scan on entry_5m
                                Recheck Cond: (tsv @@ '''ahmed'' & ''al'':*'::tsquery)
                                Filter: ((publish_state = 'published'::text) AND (country_code = 'pk'::text) AND ((place_path = 'pk.punjab.faisalabad'::text) OR (place_path ~~ 'pk.punjab.faisalabad.%'::text)))
                                ->  Bitmap Index Scan on entry_5m_tsv
                                      Index Cond: (tsv @@ '''ahmed'' & ''al'':*'::tsquery)

              SubPlan 1

              ->  Bitmap Index Scan on entry_5m_trgm
                    Index Cond: (name_fold %> 'zorlidda'::text)
